title: Map an IoT Ecosystem
description: Describe a hypothetical smart classroom IoT system: devices, sensors, actuators, communication channel, cloud service, and user interactions.

title: Identify an IoT Domain
description: For several real-world examples, determine the IoT application area and the value the system provides.

title: Classify IoT Threats
description: Group a set of IoT threats by type and briefly explain the likely consequence of each one.

title: Analyze an IIoT Risk
description: A production sensor reports incorrect temperature values. Describe the possible threat, impact, and baseline mitigation steps.

title: Investigate a Smart Watch Incident
description: Explain which categories of data may be recovered from a smart watch or paired smartphone during a forensic investigation.

title: Assess an Attack on Transport Control
description: A traffic control system receives forged density data. Determine the threat type, consequences, and detection options.

title: Design IoT Protection Measures
description: Propose at least five organizational and technical controls for a smart office system and explain which risks they reduce.

title: Describe a Secure IoT Lifecycle
description: List the stages of an IoT device lifecycle and note the main security actions required at each stage.
